name.description: the banner id, webhook name, certificate name, access label or backup id to change; for integrations servicenow or infoblox; for collection_settings organization or a collector id or name; for api_tokens the token name; for organizations the organization name or id

secret_file.description: path of a file (mode 600) holding the one secret the action needs

secret_env.description: name of an environment variable holding the secret (instead of secret_file)

definition.description: the body for the area and action; see Input details in `fwdctl run NAME --help`

confirm.description: webhook delete: the exact name; banners delete: the banner id; infoblox delete: the instance id; certificates apply: the word apply; saml set: saml; licensing apply: license; cve_index delete: cve_index; organizations disable or delete: the organization name; backups trigger: backup; backups cancel: cancel; backups delete: the id; access label delete: the name
